description: Free, offline, read-only: before sending crypto, check whether the recipient address is a lookalike (same first/last hex characters, different middle) of any address you trust, and whether its EIP-55 checksum is valid. Address poisoning stole $76M+ in 12 months by planting such lookalikes in wallet histories.

known.description: addresses you trust (address book, previous real payees)

to.description: recipient you are about to pay

name: check_recipient_lookalike
